cohort: Same archived 4002 common stocks; no 2026 IPO additions or hindsight replacements. SPY benchmark only; SOXL explicitly prohibited.
model: Unchanged sealed RM1a QR, 36 monthly returns ending formation_month minus 1; u=excess return-beta*FF3 without subtracting fitted intercept; sum(last11 u)/sample sd
eligibility_and_allocation: Unchanged SM1 raw price>=5, ADV20>=20M, 252-day SPY beta>=1.5, >=10 other original base peers, ten 10% targets, max two per archived sector, zero-interest cash, two-session delayed monthly closes, no risk overlay
factor_file: Reuse exact retained parent French ZIP; expand parser date range only. No factor vintage refresh, monthly rows only, percent converted once.
factor_vintage: Current retrospective CIZ; factor publication availability not historically certified despite calendar-month lag
history_splice: Same RM1a quarantine for old-Jan2023-empty/new-nonempty; all other January overlap exact; preserve original missing values.
new_splice: December2025 date sets and adjusted closes/raw close-volume tuples must equal original cache for every symbol. Any mismatch aborts entire study before new scores; no tolerance relaxation or silent rebasing.
calendar: Pinned exchange_calendars 4.13.2 XNYS; fresh SPY sessions must equal generated calendar for Dec2025-Sep2026
missing_held_price: Original HALT with no full-period return; keep partial audited path, no future quote-completeness selection

screen.classification: Research continuation screen, DX27 choices not paper-derived significance thresholds or automatic Paper approval
screen.complete: Both matched ordinary and matched residual full period at both costs
screen.return_positive: Matched residual return >0 at both costs
screen.return_comparison: Matched residual return > matched ordinary at both costs
screen.drawdown: Matched residual observed drawdown <=25% and <=matched ordinary at both costs
screen.gross_interval_frequency: Matched residual gross positive-stock holding-interval fraction >=50% and >=matched ordinary at both costs
screen.fail: Complete but at least one condition false; no parameter or period search
screen.incomplete: Data integrity/coverage halt prevents complete primary comparison; not a successful or failed profitability verdict

secondary: gross interval counts and basket counts, not actual trades or independent samples
beta, exposure, turnover, top-three positive-path contribution, drifted weights
audit_limits: Retained request metadata only; unlogged requests, Paper snapshots, external market knowledge and prior viewing cannot be certified. Existing current factor ZIP included later dates but parent score parser excluded them.
